_note: A hybrid: a screen take of a page and a figure take in one video. Run: node scripts/demo.mjs examples/hybrid.demo.json (copy this file and the figure/ folder out of the skill first, into a folder that survives a restart). Everything here is made up: the app, the build steps, the timings and the figure.
name: parallel-build-hybrid

app._setup: A screen take needs a URL, and a file:// one would have to be absolute. So the setup serves figure/app.html on 127.0.0.1:4791 with a node one-liner (nothing to install) that stops by itself 30 s after its last request. If one is already up, it is reused.
app._slow: Recorded 10 times slower than real time so the cursor glides smoothly on a busy machine; leave it out to let the recorder choose.

bench._note: The same take as explainer.demo.json: see the notes there.

scenes.text: Builds now run on two machines
scenes.subtitle: The result first, then where the time went

scenes._autoCamera: 1.6, not the default 1.8: the push-in frames the button and the result, and this keeps the whole card in view.

captions.text: Two machines: built in 2 m 10 s.
Each machine starts and installs first.
Lint, types and tests move to Parallel 2.
Serial only starts its compile at 1:15.
The compile lane sets the finish: 2:10.
From here on, every second is time saved.
